resources.string: Reliable FCM push notifications on HyperOS 4 China ROMs
Enable HyperFCM in LSPosed with the scope System Framework and Battery and performance, then reboot.
The phone failed to finish booting several times in a row, so HyperFCM stopped installing its hooks. Notifications to stopped apps do not work until you turn the hooks back on.
Hooks will be installed again after the next reboot.
HyperFCM only supports Xiaomi HyperOS 4 (Android 17). On other versions hooks can fail or behave differently.
Reboot once after installing or updating the module.
%1$d hook groups installed at this boot. Tap for details
%1$d of %2$d hook groups installed. Tap to see what failed
The report is from an earlier boot (%1$d of %2$d). Reboot and check again
Installed but never called: %1$s. A system update may have changed these code paths
The call count shows how often the system reached each hook since boot. Some hooks are only reached in rare situations, so zero is normal for them.
Failed: %1$s. The module may need an update after a system update; some notifications can be delayed.
Could not read the app list
Search by app or package name
Check the permission to read the app list and try again.
Check the app or package name.
Turn on an app in the list to let FCM wake it.
Only apps with a Firebase Cloud Messaging receiver are listed.
Stops HyperOS from freezing Google Play services or limiting its network while the screen is off. Needed for FCM notifications
Newly installed FCM apps are allowed by default
Keep notifications when an app is stopped
Existing notifications stay when the system stops an allowed app, for example after clearing recents
Wake apps disabled by Ice Box
When a push arrives, tries to enable an app that Ice Box disabled. Needs the Ice Box app; unrelated to the HyperOS freezer
Use the global ROM freezer policy

Runs the HyperOS freezer (Greeze) with the international policy that is built into the system instead of the China one. Reboot after changing. Experimental: background apps are restricted less, battery use can go up
No apps selected. Selected apps are never frozen or killed in the background; battery use goes up

Selected apps are not frozen by HyperOS and not killed by the memory manager in the background. Meant for apps that keep their own connection or long downloads. They keep running and use more battery, so pick only what you really need.
Keep mobile data on in sleep mode
HyperOS sleep mode keeps working, but it no longer turns mobile data off at night, so notifications still arrive
The module keeps working; open it from LSPosed
You can open HyperFCM from the module page in LSPosed and turn this option off to bring the icon back.
Could not change the launcher icon
Could not save the default settings. Reopen the app and try again
Could not save. Check that the module is active in LSPosed and try again
Saved, but only partly: some features may use the old settings until the module is active in LSPosed. Reopen the app and save again
Could not open the FCM diagnostics page
HyperOS hides most apps from HyperFCM. Allow it under Settings → Apps → HyperFCM → Permissions → Read installed apps, then open this list again.
